title: CSB investigations, recommendations, and public learning products as process-safety correction rail
summary: CSB is encoded as process-safety correction infrastructure: independent/nonregulatory investigation, root-cause analysis, public reports/videos, and recommendation tracking. It is not proof that recommendations are complete, adopted, or sufficient.

place.scope: United States / professional process-safety infrastructure unless otherwise stated

claims.claim: The CSB describes itself as an independent, nonregulatory federal agency charged with investigating facts, conditions, circumstances, and causes/probable causes of accidental chemical releases causing fatality, serious injury, or substantial property damage.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The CSB says it conducts root-cause investigations, does not issue fines or citations, and makes safety recommendations to companies, industry associations, standards bodies, labor groups, regulatory agencies, and others.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The CSB page says recommendations are its principal tool for achieving positive safety change, and that implementation is tracked and monitored until satisfactory actions can be closed by Board vote.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

limitations: Does not establish completeness, compliance, adoption, or effectiveness.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: major chemical incident deployment, evidence collection, public investigation, findings, recommendations, advocacy and tracking
limitations: nonregulatory and does not issue fines/citations
recommendations can require extensive advocacy and are not automatically implemented
CSB coverage is incident-selective and jurisdictional

handling_notes: Infrastructure records describe visibility/correction rails, not proof that accidents are prevented.
Regulatory/program descriptions must be rechecked before policy or compliance use.

unknowns: Recommendation or rule change closure not yet extracted.
next_actions: Pair with actual incident child records and recommendation-closure audits.
